native_mechanisms: Low sun / doubled shadow: detect every same-dye knot crossing (match) in one sweep, without visiting cells one by one.

Corridor cost read off rope lengths: the cost between consecutive treasures is computed arithmetically from how many knots each rope advances, never by laying markers on the bare floor between matches.
At each treasure keep only the cheapest arriving tally in each of two states (slip already spent / slip still whole) and drop every dominated tally — a single bounded slip between the two ropes.
core_technique: Banded Needleman-Wunsch DP (scalar rows plus an AVX2 anti-diagonal wavefront) with the band width iteratively widened from a score lower bound; the main-diagonal SIMD match count only supplies that initial bound.
